values.en: The derivative is defined by reusing the limit layer verbatim: it is the limit at `x₀` of the difference quotient, itself formed in the PFun algebra, so the domain bookkeeping is inherited rather than repeated.
values.zh-CN: 导数完全复用极限层来定义：它是差商在 `x₀` 处的极限，而差商本身在 PFun 代数中构造，因此定义域的管理由此继承，无须重复。
